function rank_teams(votes)
canonical_solution:
function rank_teams(votes)
  local m = #votes[1]
  local counts = {}
  local letters = {}
  for _, v in ipairs(votes) do
    for i = 1, #v do
      local ch = v:sub(i, i)
      if counts[ch] == nil then
        counts[ch] = {}
        for k = 1, m do counts[ch][k] = 0 end
        letters[#letters + 1] = ch
      end
      counts[ch][i] = counts[ch][i] + 1
    end
  end
  table.sort(letters, function(a, b)
    for k = 1, m do
      if counts[a][k] ~= counts[b][k] then
        return counts[a][k] > counts[b][k]
      end
    end
    return a < b
  end)
  return table.concat(letters)
end

    """
    An niveroù anterin pozitivel a ha m n'o deus rannerez boutin ebet estreget 1. Distroit ar c'hontrol liesaat eus a modulo m, da lavaret eo an anterin x gant 0 <= x < m ma chom 1 pa vez rannet a gwezh x gant m.

    """
canonical_solution:
def inverse_mod(a: int, m: int) -> int:
    old_r, r = a % m, m
    old_s, s = 1, 0
    while r:
        q = old_r // r
        old_r, r = r, old_r - q * r
